parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: HttpRewriteJSON
parameters.description: The information about the rewrite policy. The JSON format is supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-gateway-route-http-rewrite --id 238 --gateway-id 430 --http-rewrite-json pathType_:_PRE_,_path_:_/_,_status_:_off --gateway-unique-id gw-90392d768a3847a7b804c505254da96d --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
